title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Ice Pop Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Ice Pop serves up a nostalgic frozen treat flavour with a mix of sweet fruits and a cool exhale. It’s a smooth, uplifting vape that combines sugary fruit notes with a frosty edge for a perfectly chilled finish. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod comes as a prefilled 2ml pod connected to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No coil changes or manual refilling required—simply attach it to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. A dual mesh coil ensures consistent performance and flavour clarity for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
